children: Industrial production in France fell 0.4% month-on-month in July 2026, missing market expectations for a 0.3% rebound after a revised 0.1% decline in June.
Manufacturing output dropped 0.8% after falling 1% in the previous period, as production declined across almost all major sectors.
Transport equipment manufacturing led the declines, falling 2.8% after a 3.8% drop in June, while output of other industrial products decreased 0.5% for a second month.
Production of electrical, electronic, and computer equipment fell 0.8%, reversing a 0.2% increase, while food processing output was broadly stable at -0.1%.
In contrast, production in extractive industries, energy, and water rose 0.9%, slowing from 3.2%, driven by stronger electricity production and consumption during the second heat wave.
On a yearly basis, industrial production fell 0.5%, following a 0.1% decline in June, while production increased 0.8% in the three months to July.

title: France Industrial Output Misses Expectations
